name: GAINS Stage II: Material Properties
definition: Joint optimization of material properties M = {(aj, rj, mj)} and environment lighting L over 7000 additional iterations, using re-rendering loss Lcolor augmented with segmentation, IID, and diffusion priors to resolve ill-posedness and overfitting.
summary: GAINS Stage II jointly optimizes material properties and lighting using segmentation-based consistency, intrinsic image decomposition, and multi-illuminated score distillation to prevent overfitting and enable robust relighting.
